text:
Meera S.: quick heads-up — I opened a PR to add a short heuristics page for Optimize toolkit: batching + cache + quant recs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/838 (draft)
Alex P.: thanks! can you summarize the migration guidance for teams using older quant profiles? want to bubble that into the release notes.
Meera S.: yup. plan is: 1) map old profile names to new recommended profiles, 2) show a tiny SDK snippet demonstrating how to opt into per-route batching and prefix-KV caching, 3) note accuracy caveats for 4-bit vs 8-bit. keeping it short.
Jordan (Docs): please include a short, copyable example config. reviewers prefer minimal runnable examples we can paste into the docs site. also need a changelog blurb.
Meera S.: putting an example in the PR — small node snippet + an example quant-profile YAML. will also add a migration checklist section.
Sam T.: can you add a quick note about when to *not* use aggressive batching? e.g., sub-100ms SLOs and heavy instruction-following workloads — batching tradeoffs matter.
Meera S.: good call. will add a sentence and a one-line decision tree.
Alex P.: CI flagged the examples link to the SDK package names — previously we used @redwood/sdk, new packages use @redwood/inference-js. ci-bot will show the install step failing.
ci-bot: build/docs-examples failed: import error in examples/node/snippet.js — module not found '@redwood/sdk'. See logs: https://ci.redwood/838/logs
Meera S.: thanks — fixed the snippet imports in the PR and pushed. also replaced a deprecated option `cache_prefetch: true` with `kv_prefetch: {enabled: true}` per the runtime changes.
Jordan (Docs): can you paste the final snippet here so I can sanity-check copy style before merging?
Meera S.: sure — snippet below:
```
// Node SDK: enable per-route batching + prefix KV prefetch
import {RedwoodClient} from '@redwood/inference-js';
const client = new RedwoodClient({apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY});

await client.createRoute('summarize', {
  model: 'open-llama-13b-v2',
  batching: {maxTokensPerBatch: 1024, maxBatchSize: 8, timeoutMs: 12},
  kv_prefetch: {enabled: true, ttlSeconds: 300}
});
```
Meera S.: and the YAML mapping for quant profiles:
```
# quant-profiles.yml
legacy-small: q4_0 -- use q4_0 or q8_0 depending on accuracy tests
legacy-large: q8_0 -- prefer q8_0 for instruction workloads
```
Jordan (Docs): looks good. adjust the inline phrasing to avoid promises ("will") in docs — use present-tense imperative: "Enable KV prefetch for latency-sensitive reuse." Also add the one-line caveat about 4-bit: "q4 may reduce perplexity-sensitive outputs; validate on your eval set."
Sam T.: tiny nit: change timeoutMs to 10 in the snippet to match runtime defaults.
Meera S.: updated to 10 and tweaked wording. requesting @Alex P. for review on migration mapping.
Alex P.: reviewing now. will leave comments on the PR for wording and a quick benchmark number request (cost vs latency for q4_0 vs q8_0 on batching=8).
Jordan (Docs): if you want a docs-only quicklink, add an anchor id #optkit-heuristics so we can reference from the release notes.
Meera S.: done. tagging for final merge once Alex finishes review. thanks all :tada:
